warning.titlePre: Jaguar XF XFR 5.0 Supercharged V8 Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: The AJ133S is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ133S V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ133S rebuild.
Because the XF XFR 5.0 Supercharged V8 uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the XF 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established AJ133S specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
